title: MultiAgentBench: Evaluating the Collaboration and Competition of LLM agents
abstract: arXiv:2503.01935v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities as autonomous agents, yet existing benchmarks either focus on single-agent tasks or are confined to narrow domains, failing to capture the dynamics of multi-agent coordination and competition. In this paper, we introduce MultiAgentBench, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate LLM-based multi-agent systems across diverse, interactive scenarios. Our framework measures not only task completion but also the quality of collaboration and competition using novel, milestone-based key performance indicators. Moreover, we evaluate various coordination protocols (including star, chain, tree, and graph topologies) and innovative strategies such as group discussion and cognitive planning. translated_title: MultiAgentBench：评估大语言模型智能体的协作与竞争
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）作为自主智能体已展现出卓越能力，但现有基准要么聚焦于单智能体任务，要么局限于狭窄领域，无法捕捉多智能体协调与竞争的动态特性。本文提出了MultiAgentBench，一个旨在跨多样化交互场景评估基于LLM的多智能体系统的综合基准。我们的框架不仅衡量任务完成情况，还通过新颖的基于里程碑的关键性能指标来衡量协作与竞争的质量。此外，我们评估了多种协调协议（包括星形、链式、树形和图拓扑结构）以及群体讨论和认知规划等创新策略。值得注意的是，gpt-4o-mini获得了平均最高的任务分数，图结构在研究场景的协调协议中表现最佳，认知规划提升了里程碑达成率。
tldr: 提出了综合基准MultiAgentBench，利用新颖的基于里程碑的性能指标评估LLM多智能体系统在多样化交互场景中的任务完成、协作与竞争质量，并系统比较了不同协调拓扑结构与群体讨论、认知规划等创新策略的效果。
en_tdlr: Introduces MultiAgentBench, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates LLM-based multi-agent systems across diverse interactive scenarios, using novel milestone-based KPIs to measure task completion, collaboration, and competition quality across various coordination protocols and innovative strategies such as group discussion and cognitive planning.
